page_title: NAP 0-3 ATA | Napoli v Atalanta 03/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Daniele Doveri is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) receives a yellow card.
90+3' David Neres (Napoli) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90+3' Having seen unsporting behavior, Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) is the recipient.
90+2' 0 - 3 What a goal! Raoul Bellanova plays it to Mateo Retegui (Atalanta), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Alex Meret into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) tackles a bit over-zealously and Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
86' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Cyril Ngonge (Napoli). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) is coming onto the pitch as Mario Pasalic cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Davide Zappacosta and he is replaced by Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta).

80' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Marco Carnesecchi was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
79' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
76' Here comes a substitution. Mathias Olivera is given a rest as he is replaced by Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli).
76' Substitution. Romelu Lukaku makes his way off the pitch and Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) comes on as his replacement.
76' Here is a change. Ademola Lookman is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
76' Substitution. Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) in, Charles De Ketelaere out.
75' Close! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
75' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
71' Antonio Conte decides to make a substitution. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia will be replaced by David Neres (Napoli).
71' We are about to witness a subsitution. Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) for Sead Kolasinac.
68' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
68' The corner from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is intercepted by the defence.
67' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Doveri had a clear view and blows his whistle.
66' A header by Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) from very close range goes towards the left-hand post, but doesn't get past Marco Carnesecchi, who makes a brilliant save.
65' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Doveri had an easy-decision to make.
64' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
62' Antonio Conte has decided to make a change. Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) replaces Billy Gilmour.
62' Here comes a substitution. Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) is brought on as a substitute for Matteo Politano.
61' Ederson (Atalanta) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just over the bar.
60' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
60' Matteo Politano (Napoli) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
57' A goal, which was scored by Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta), was disallowed due to offside.
57' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) will take the corner.
56' The resulting corner from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

56' What a chance that is! Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
53' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) sends a cross in and finds Ademola Lookman inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
50' Matteo Politano (Napoli) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
48' Flag goes up against Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
47' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
46' It's a nice effort by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Marco Carnesecchi. Easy save.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post!
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
44' A player from Atalanta commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
41' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
40' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
36' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle and it's Mathias Olivera (Napoli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
33' A shot from the edge of the box by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is close, but lifts narrowly over the bar at the last second.
31' 0 - 2 What a beauty from just outside the box! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the right post.
30' A dangerous looking corner kick from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is cleared to safety by the defence.
30' Matteo Politano (Napoli) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
26' That's unlucky! Frank Anguissa (Napoli) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
25' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
24' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) receives a reproachful look from Ademola Lookman. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails well wide of the right post.
23' Daniele Doveri couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Frank Anguissa (Napoli) and blew his whistle.
23' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
19' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
19' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
16' Poor challenge! Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) is penalised for tripping and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle.
15' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
14' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
12' Foul! Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
11' Scott McTominay (Napoli) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
10' 0 - 1 What a hit! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.

9' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Marco Carnesecchi pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
4' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) attempts to find Romelu Lukaku, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
2' The foul by Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) was seen by Daniele Doveri who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Daniele Doveri got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
